text:
Ana: Quick sync — draft proposal for Design Partner incentives + feedback routing. TL;DR: three incentive tiers, white-glove onboarding for on-prem, and a simple scoreboard that maps feedback -> backlog priority.
Chris: Nice. Can you list the tiers and expected cost per partner?
Ana: Tier A: full onboarding + $10k credits + co-marketing. Tier B: self-serve onboarding + $2k credits. Tier C: early-access only (no $$). Ballpark monthly cost: A ~ $1.5k, B ~ $300, C $0 (per partner amortized).
Jamal: For on-prem / VPC partners we should always go A. They need HSM/KMS support and a runbook. Also require a 30d commit window.
Sophie: +1. Also propose a 2-week white-glove onboarding checklist: access, sample prompts, eval harness, and escalation contact. I can add a template.
Maria: Success criteria we should gate on: 1) integration completed, 2) >=1 production flow using Redwood API, 3) signal quality metrics (see below). If not met in 45d, we downgrade cohort.
Chris: For signal scoring, propose a lightweight rubric:
```
score = sum([
  3 if reproducible_issue else 0,
  2 if business_impact_high else 1,
  1 if needs minor product tweak else 0
])
```
Map scores: 5-6 -> P0 backlog, 3-4 -> P1, <=2 -> monitor.
Ana: Nice — we should capture these signals via a canonical tag: `/dp-feedback` in the console and a one-click export to GH issues.
dp-bot: New intake form created: https://redwood.internal/dp-intake (auto-tag: dp-feedback) :rocket:
Jamal: Privacy note — intake must include data sensitivity level and whether we need an NDA addendum. Add a KMS checkbox.
Sophie: Sampling cadence: week 1 smoke tests, week 2-4 rolling evals (NPS + regen rate + false-positive rate). We'll store evals with the partner id.
Maria: Launch gating proposal: infra SLOs met for 72h in staging, no regressions >1% on quality baseline, and partner integration passing end-to-end tests. If gating fails we triage and plan a hotfix window.
Chris: Can someone put numbers on expected workloads? I need QPS and median latency targets to size Dedicated pools for Tier A.
Ana: I'll follow up with traffic estimates; Jamal can own KMS/runbook; Sophie will drop onboarding template; Maria will write gating checklist.
Maria: Suggested rollout: 3 Tier-A partners first month, 8 Tier-B staggered over 6 weeks. That gives us enough signal volume without overcommitting SRE.
Sophie: I'll create the eval prompt set and a short playbook for partner engineers.
Ana: Action items: @Chris - sizing; @Jamal - security checklist; @Sophie - onboarding + eval; @Maria - gating doc; @Ana - finalize incentive terms and publish intake link. Can we reconvene Thursday?
Chris: Thursday works for me. :thumbsup:
Jamal: Works. Added a note to the security backlog.
Sophie: I'll post the onboarding template by EOD tomorrow.
Maria: I'll draft the gating doc tonight and share comments.
Ana: Thanks all — small, fast cohorts + clear signals. :seedling:
